correctness.rationale: Complete explicit Fano incidence/perfect-matching enumeration gives 24 facets, 2201 perfect faces, 3461 ordinary faces. Two exact acyclic discrete-Morse matchings verified over all 8736 and 14574 Hasse incidences yield homotopy wedges of sixteen spheres in degrees 2 and 4. All 336 graph automorphisms are generated from 168 invertible binary matrices and polarity; two independent exact Lefschetz algorithms agree for each automorphism and complex, proving the full character table and sign twist via Maschke. The executable proof and exact reference output are embedded.

value.rationale: The complete equivariant character is a meaningful new invariant for two natural Heawood matching constructions with the same sixteen-fold homology multiplicity. All 336 symmetries reveal that the side-preserving homology modules agree but point-line dualities reverse their character, producing a duality-odd perfect-complex invariant line and zero full-group invariants versus a full-group invariant in the ordinary complex. This is not entailed by known nonequivariant wedge types or the ordinary complex character.
